body:
I have been getting high since I was 11 years old.  We use to twirl around real fast and then someone would catch you and press thier arms around your chest and squeeze real hard...most of the time ending up in a faint.  There are two types of poeple I know... those who have some kind of control over a vice or all thier vices and those who have no control over one vice or all thier vices. I am under the second type and have always shunned away from the first type due to embarassment, since I put on a pretty good show (I could have been a actress), over my lack of control. Over the years my one addiction will change some times even to just joints but I have never, since I can remember, been straight, oh pardon...my lust for a ECK man and the beautiful philosohy of Eck,. did for 3 weeks stop all my cravings and usage ...including cigarettes.... except when the lust left for a Eck conference my cleaness went with him. After fainting it was inhaling acetone and then on to LSD..real lab-made LSD...not what you see now. I must have been doing LSD for two years before I first smoked hash...which I didn't like at first. And then on to pot and everything else.
I have recently started kicking and smoking base just to get a familiarity since I always have used my nose which is now, after two bad bouts with the C... even with a decade in between the bouts.... fried and beyond repair beyond surgery...no thanks...The city coke is not really coke and doesn't hurt my nose...I have been using 90+% from Bolivia for over two years and sometimes cut my own stash with inistol to give my system a break. Life is hard!!!! Some of us may seem spoiled but for the price you pay (not $$) is it worth it????  I now have a slight handle on a routine I've started....party nicely for days' then go on a eating, reading, study, sleeping, etc. for three weeks and voila! My weight comes back..my breasts are again noticable and I am free to party again, guilt free, as long as I stop before I get under 100#...now I am 113#...had a surprise gift tonight and am doing it every which way I can...also making oil since the smell of pot is still a dangerous thing where I live...so yes life can be good!!! Thank-You Sugmad and Ou shanti to all.....An Aries..45yrs + feeling good......maybe one day I'll grow up but I hope not!!!!
